title: Everything Claude Code — A battle-tested toolkit of agents crafted by Anthropic hackathon winner
description:
Created by Anthropic hackathon winner, this repository isn't just a list of prompts; it's a battle-tested configuration suite that turns Claude Code from a chat bot into a senior engineer. It includes custom "Skills" for test-driven development, automated "Hooks" that lint and type-check every file the AI writes. If you want to stop fighting with context windows and start shipping production code, this is the config you need to clone.

https://github.com/affaan-m/everything-claude-code
